title: Discover Benidorm: Beaches, Old Town and Holiday Ideas
summary: Explore Benidorm, from its famous beaches to the historic old town.
body:
Benidorm is a popular Costa Blanca holiday destination, known for its long sandy beaches and lively atmosphere.

Spend time on Levante Beach, explore the lanes of the old town and visit the Balcón del Mediterráneo viewpoint.

For a quieter day, consider Poniente Beach. Check opening times and booking conditions for attractions before you travel.

title: Lanzarote Holiday Guide: Volcanoes, Beaches and Excursions
summary: Ideas for exploring Lanzarote’s volcanic landscapes and coastal resorts.
body:
Lanzarote offers striking volcanic scenery, beautiful coastlines and varied holiday resorts.

Timanfaya National Park is a memorable highlight. Other popular places include the work of César Manrique and the island’s beaches.

Check local access arrangements, weather and excursion details before booking.

title: Your First Cruise: Simple Planning Tips
summary: A practical checklist for first-time cruise passengers.
body:
Before booking your first cruise, compare itineraries, cabin locations and what the fare includes.

Check passport and entry requirements, travel insurance, baggage allowances and embarkation instructions.

Once onboard, use the ship’s daily programme to plan activities and allow enough time to return from shore visits.
